images.caption: A bold, hot-pink character piece with a rounded face and a trailing bubble is stenciled on the lower side of a silver AOK hopper, 600781, now centered in frame. It moves along a tree-lined cut before a wide, grey lake.

A large white and red piece with bold lettering and a blocky character face dominates the side of a BNSF boxcar 485305, sitting clean against the maroon paint. The car rolls along a tree-lined cut with a wide river and distant hills behind it.

A teal and green wildstyle piece with a white circular emblem sits low on the side of a maroon BNSF hopper 475016, the only real paint on an otherwise clean maroon train. The car rolls past a lake with a tall evergreen framing the middle of the shot.

A row of hand-drawn cartoon character faces and heads in black outline is spaced along the side of a white AGPX hopper, a deliberate pictorial strip rather than lettering. The car sits in a tree-lined cut beside a wide river under an overcast sky.

A composed white piece reading 'Yeah, I'm' with a skull-and-crossbones character and the tag 'J'z' is worked into the side of BNSF boxcar 481955, the skull giving the piece a deliberate, character-driven look. The car is centered against a quiet lake and a stand of conifers.
A teal skull character with a green halo sits low on a BNSF boxcar, blended into a grey and pink lettered piece. The skull face is the focal point of the otherwise red car.
A pink-and-white bubble-letter tag with a small character worked into the lower panel of a maroon BNSF boxcar, the lettering softened by motion blur.
A low multi-color piece runs along the side of a grey boxcar: a green shape beside a tan bear-like figure, with blocky lettering to the left. A clean car is clipped at the right edge.
The same low multi-color piece on a grey boxcar, a green shape and tan animal figure with blocky lettering, is the only paint on an otherwise plain car. A clean car is clipped at the right.

A muted, multi-colored character mural with organic shapes and shading covers the lower side of a cream boxcar, the kind of composed piece this camera exists to catch. The train rolls past a wide, hazy river with a tree-lined far shore under a heavy overcast sky.

A cream boxcar carries a chunky white character with a grinning face and a matching purple block-letter throw-up, a small multi-color piece that pops against the off-white panel. The car is lettered COER 131117 at the left end.

A multi-color piece with red and purple lettering and a green splash sits low on a maroon BNSF boxcar, the letters stacked in two rows. The car is lettered BNSF 489167, moving past tall pines and a river under a flat grey sky.
A multi-color piece with a small character and lettering sits low on the brown boxcar's side, the standout art of the pass. A brown boxcar rolls past a lake with a tagged neighbor to its right.
The same BNSF boxcar 492099 is now centered, its green and white graffiti piece fully readable across the panel. A clean BNSF boxcar sits behind it to the left.

A teal and green multi-color piece with stylized lettering and a small character face sits low on the side of a BNSF boxcar (492255). The paint pops against the maroon body on an overcast river crossing.

A maroon boxcar carries a dense, multi-color piece in pinks, teals, and whites along its lower side, with a small character figure worked into the lettering. A tan TTX well car with blue tag work is sliding in at the right.

A maroon boxcar shows a busy multi-color piece in whites, pinks, and teals along its lower side, with a small character figure in the middle. A tan TTX well car with a blue 'REP' tag is at the left edge.

A multi-color piece in teal, orange, and white with a small character or shape worked into the lettering splashes across the left panel of a maroon BNSF hopper. The motion blurs the linework, but the burst of color against the bare car makes it the standout of the pass.

A colorful mural of stylized characters fills the lower panel of a tan TTX boxcar, the figures rendered in bright blues and pinks with bold outlines. The car is partly obscured by a foreground pine as it moves past a dark tank car.

The same composed teal-and-orange piece with character work is now fully in frame on a BNSF hopper lettered 49840x, the BNSF logo and number visible at the left. A grey car with a black tag is clipped at the left edge.

A composed multi-color piece in teal, orange and purple covers the lower half of a BNSF hopper (49840x), with stylized lettering and character work worked into the design. The BNSF logo is partly obscured by the paint.

A small blue character piece with a stylized face is worked into a patch of white lettering along the lower side of a dark TCIx tank car lettered 250837. The car sits on the near track with a second tank car passing on the far track behind the trees.
A bold red and white letter piece covers the lower half of a TTX intermodal well car, standing out against the yellow body. A black UTLX tank car follows closely behind on the right.

A multi-color wildstyle piece in blue, white, and green fills the lower left panel of a TTX intermodal well car, with a matching purple and blue throw-up on the right. The car is lettered TTX 675480 and bears a red and blue 'X' logo. The scene is a tree-lined trackside against a hazy lake on an overcast day.

The cream-and-yellow food-themed pictorial piece fills the lower panel of a maroon BNSF boxcar, 485643, the BNSF logo still clean above it. The car sits centered against a grey river and forested far shore, a lone tree to its right.

A white and green wildstyle piece with a circular emblem and flowing linework covers the side of a BNSF hopper (473456), the white block standing out against the maroon car. The pass runs along a lake with a forested far shore.
A tan boxcar displays the same painted gray angular shape with hatched lines and a blue block, a modest pictorial piece on a plain panel.

A white hopper car carries a large, detailed mural featuring dark, stylized characters or figures across its entire side. The piece is a complex, composed work that stands out against the natural background.

A colorful, multi-letter piece, possibly reading 'BUBA', is painted on the lower side of a BNSF boxcar, number 495257, in a mix of blue, orange, and white. The car is positioned centrally, with the clean boxcar from the previous frame now on its right.

A BNSF boxcar 470266 carries a long, multi-color piece of interlocked letters across its mid-panel, with a small character or emblem worked into the design on the right side. The piece is dense and colorful, a real effort on the maroon livery.
